# Sweep the 13.2 notes' merges since 6fd8f8b774

## Context

The 13.2 notes (`.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.2.0.md`, banner "iteration 3 of N") were last swept up to `6fd8f8b774` by #19226 (closed 2026-09-25). The #14800 cut list keeps that commit as the start of the sweep at the cut. The cut has not happened yet. Measured at `036cb05a40`, `dev` has 90 first-parent commits since then, and 37 of them touch engine paths (`src`, `apps`, `examples`, `resources/scss`).

Sweeps:
- **Live:** the latest 20 open neo issues at 2026-10-05T09:41Z; no equivalent.
- **A2A:** the latest 30 messages in all read states; no claim on the notes.
- **Memory Core:** #19185 and #19226 already ran interim sweeps between iterations, and the cut list holds the last sweep point for the cut.
- **Own assignments:** #14800 (the parent) and #15000 (unrelated).

## The Problem

Ten days of engine work are not in the notes. The release-notes discipline prices mining by how cold the arcs have gone. The window carries at least three arcs that tell a story:
- **The cross-window dock vessel:** conversion, park and replay (`#19241`, `#19243`, `#19278`, `#19296`, `#19350`, `#19186`), and the Workstation's popup return (`#19273`, `#19264`, `#19279`). This is cornerstone 4's "a second window never kills the first".
- **`Neo.canvas.GraphScene`:** a WebGL2 graph scene on the canvas worker with a foveated LOD (`#19261`, `#19295`, `#19290`). With it, `SharedCanvas` now pauses while its window is hidden (`#19336`).
- **Grid and data:** `grid.Body`'s `scrollEdge`, and Store appends that keep their results and scroll position (`#19356`, `#19359`, `#19368`).

The rest are fixes a user may notice (main-thread input `#19303` / `#19305` / `#19220`, draggable focus, tooltip, tab overflow, markdown list start) or internal changes.

A sweep that only adds lines can leave stale numbers behind. `#19354` moved the dock header actions into `plugin/HeaderActions.mjs`, which can change the dock-package figures chapter 1 measured.

## The Architectural Reality

- `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.2.0.md` is the authored path that `publish.mjs` reads (`release-notes-workflow.md` §6).
- **The #14800 cut list sets the method:**
  - a line for each merge that changes what a 13.2 user sees;
  - an upgrade row for each behaviour change;
  - everything else goes to the Full Changelog.
  The Full Changelog instrument on #14800 partitions by title scope, then by changed paths.
- **Scope is engine-only** (#14800, scope ruling 2026-09-23). The window's `docs(adr)`, `docs(agentos)` and dependency bumps either ride the Full Changelog or fall outside the engine line.

## The Fix

One iteration PR on `v13.2.0.md`:
1. Disposition every engine-path first-parent merge in `6fd8f8b774..<PR base>`: a chapter line with its PR link, an upgrade row, or the Full Changelog bucket.
2. Mine each arc that earns more than a line (one Memory Core sweep per arc) before writing it.
3. Re-measure, at the PR base, the chapter figures this window can move (dock package modules and lines, `Workspace.mjs` size), and name the instrument.
4. Move the banner to "iteration 4 of N", and move the #14800 cut list's sweep point to the PR base.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every engine-path first-parent merge in the window is dispositioned, and the PR body gives the count for each disposition.
- [ ] Every new claim links its PR. Every number the window could move is re-measured at the PR base, with the command shown.
- [ ] Any added Mermaid renders (TD for chains longer than ~5 nodes).
- [ ] The banner reads iteration 4, and the #14800 cut list names the new sweep point.
- [ ] A cross-family review approves before the merge.

## Out of Scope

- **The cut itself:** designations, final counts, and re-pointing `blob/dev` links to the tag (the #14800 cut list).
- **The Brain and Institution lines:** each writes its own notes.
- **#19166:** the portal and its generators still read the deleted mirror.
